pass.answer: 4. Delete any newly staged installer under `%LOCALAPPDATA%\Amazon\Kindle\updates`.
Run `bash sync-finalize.sh` after you quit Kindle.
If a KindleForPC-installer.exe appeared during the sync, remove it before anything else.

If Kindle offers an update, install it so you're on the latest version.
